mechanism: in single ER-containing dendritic spines, the STIM1-ORAI1 coupling triggered by RyR-dependent ER Ca2+ release is required for late structural LTP; AnCoA4 (blocks STIM1 binding to the ORAI1 C terminus) abolishes it while Synta66 (pore block) does not, so the physical interaction rather than the Ca2+ entry carries the effect; cultured hippocampal neurons, species not stated in the cached text
sentence: Surprisingly, the physical interaction between STIM1 and Orai1 induced by ER Ca2+ release, but not the resulting Ca2+ entry through Orai1 channels, proved necessary for the persistent increases in both spine size and ER content required for expression of long-lasting late sLTP.
justification: Separates a non-conducting, structural role of the STIM1-ORAI1 complex from its channel function, using two inhibitors with different modes of action: an edge whose consequence does not go through Ca2+ entry.

mechanism: canonical STIM1, not the long muscle variant STIM1L, functionally couples to PMCA1 and enhances Ca2+ extrusion in human myotubes; proposed to relieve Ca2+-dependent inactivation of ORAI1
sentence: Furthermore, STIM1 but not STIM1L functionally interacts with PMCA1, enhancing Ca2+ extrusion.
justification: The ER Ca2+ sensor driving the plasma-membrane extrusion pump, the counterpart of SOCE at the same membrane; distinguishes the canonical STIM1 isoform from STIM1L.

mechanism: SOCE induced by canonical STIM1 drives NFATc1 nuclear translocation at rest and on stimulation, STIM1L-dependent SOCE does not; human myotubes
sentence: Additionally, STIM1L-dependent SOCE did not trigger NFATc1 translocation, while the SOCE induced by STIM1 led to NFATc1 translocation both at rest and under stimulated conditions.
justification: STIM1 to NFATC1 in human muscle, with the isoform split: only the canonical sensor's SOCE reaches the transcription factor.

mechanism: PMCA1 knockdown lowers basal Ca2+ entry and NFATc1 translocation in human myotubes
sentence: In parallel, the downregulation of PMCA1 decreased basal Ca2+ entry as well as NFATc1 translocation.
justification: Closes STIM1 -> PMCA1 -> NFATc1: the extrusion pump is needed for the SOCE-to-NFAT signal, not only for clearing Ca2+.

mechanism: overexpression of NFATc isoforms raises STIM2 mRNA and protein and SOCE in C2C12 myoblasts; NFATc1 named
sentence: Overexpression of NFATc1 increased STIM2 expression and SOCE activity.
justification: The feedback loop known for NFATc3 -> STIM1 extended to the second sensor: NFAT signalling raises STIM2 abundance and store-operated entry.

mechanism: Tyr316 in coiled-coil 1 keeps STIM1 auto-inhibited; the Y316A mutant clusters constitutively near the plasma membrane and activates ORAI1 CRAC channels in resting cells
sentence: Full-length STIM1-Y316A formed constitutive clusters near the plasma membrane and activated the CRAC channel in the resting state when co-expressed with Orai1.
justification: A residue-level handle on the auto-inhibition that keeps STIM1 from gating ORAI1 at rest.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation of TRPC1 and TRPC4 with STIM1 after ER Ca2+ store depletion in lung endothelial cells; SOCE there needs STIM1 but not ORAI1 or ORAI3
sentence: Coimmunoprecipitation studies showed coupling of TRPC1 and TRPC4 with STIM1 on depletion of ER Ca(2+) stores.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation with STIM1 after store depletion, murine and human lung endothelial cells
